title: High-Temperature Oxidation and Phase Stability of AlCrCoFeNi High Entropy Alloy: Insights from In Situ HT-XRD and Thermodynamic Calculations.

recollection.intervention: High-temperature oxidation and in situ high-temperature X-ray diffraction (HT-XRD) combined with thermodynamic calculations
recollection.structure: Oxidized phases and potentially stable high-entropy alloy phases at elevated temperatures
recollection.mechanism: Oxidation and phase stability influenced by thermodynamic and kinetic factors at high temperatures
recollection.results: Likely quantitative data on oxidation rates, phase composition, and stability as a function of temperature, but this is a guess.

score.note: The recollection mostly paraphrases the title: it identifies high-temperature oxidation, HT-XRD, and thermodynamic calculations but gives no specific temperature range, atmosphere comparison, phase evolution, oxide-layer structure, selective Al/Cr oxidation mechanism, or numerical results.
